Use cases

What CNC Punching Job Work Covers

CNC punching is practical when sheet metal parts need repeated holes, slots, notches, louvers or cutouts with consistent positioning. It is often faster and more economical than laser cutting for repetitive sheet patterns within the suitable thickness range.

Panel Work

Electrical panels, ventilation panels, cable trays, rack panels, perforated sheets, machine guards and punched industrial covers.

Enclosure Parts

Meter cutouts, switch holes, gland openings, fan vents, hinge holes, lock slots and repeatable mounting points for control panel builders.

Production Support

Useful for OEMs, fabrication shops and engineering suppliers that need reliable local punching capacity without investing in their own turret punching setup.

Common questions

Before Sending a CNC Punching Job

When is CNC punching suitable?

It is a strong fit for repeated holes, slots, louvers, perforations and panel cutouts, especially where repeatability and speed matter across many parts.

Do you need a DXF file?

A DXF is best for accurate quoting and production. For early discussion, a drawing, sketch or sample photo with dimensions can help us check feasibility.

Can punching and bending be combined?

Yes. If the part bends after punching, we review bend lines and hole positions together so the finished part matches the intended assembly.
